title: The Window Left Open in the Mist
youtube_title: The Window Left Open in the Mist | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Brisa is tangled up with a window you left open, and a damp sill and almost hides it. Brisa tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
